extracted.subtask_description: A web-based curriculum (with versions for journalists and the general public) that teaches users how to verify the accuracy and credibility of different types of media, focusing on processes of information production and dissemination using interactive online modules/games.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify accuracy and credibility of media
rubrics_metrics.description: Teach users how to verify the accuracy and credibility of different types of media (there are versions for both journalists and for the general public).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First Draft's web-based 'verification curriculum' is designed to teach users how to verify the accuracy and credibility of different types of media. The curriculum is delivered as an online course or game and is available in versions tailored to journalists and to the general public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate how information is produced and disseminated (process-focused)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess the processes by which information is created and spreads, rather than only focusing on individual content items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tool focus is described as 'process-focused' — it evaluates how information is produced and disseminated. The curriculum therefore emphasizes understanding provenance, production chains, and distribution mechanisms as part of verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop media literacy to identify and avoid non-credible sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Build a cohort of more-media-literate information consumers and savvy journalists who can identify and avoid information sources that lack credibility or accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How the tool addresses disinformation: 'This tool aims to fight disinformation by creating a cohort of more-media-literate information consumers and savvy journalists who are able to identify and avoid information sources that lack credibility or accuracy.' The curriculum's objective-driven guidance is to produce users capable of source evaluation and avoidance of unreliable sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of interactive/automated online training methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver verification training through an online course or game that includes automated elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Method or technology: 'Online course or game'. Is the tool automated? 'Yes.' The curriculum's format and automation are part of its instructional approach, implying criteria about scalability, interactivity, and self-guided verification practice.
